comingLast.roast: in the clubhouse on 23, and yes, everyone knows where he is sitting
on 14 - his caddy (his mate with the beers) has gone quiet
escape number: 8. holes remaining: 5. belief in the clubhouse: modest.
the rescue mission: 4 points, 4 holes, no pressure at all
3 left, 2 needed, one bar holding its breath
on 22 with 3 to play - scratch the plan, just add points, any points
on 23 at 1.4 - his playing partners are witnesses now, not opponents
his round is over, his sweating is not - 1 above the line
in the clubhouse 2 above Crouch - cheering for him from a safe distance
in the clubhouse 3 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
